description: This script automates building Python wheel packages, managing virtual environments, and finding supported Python interpreters, particularly in manylinux environments. It includes functions for running commands, parsing versions, and handling build processes.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: Handles building wheel packages, cleaning build artifacts, and installing requirements using a specified Python interpreter.

methods.name: run_cmd
methods.description: Executes a command with optional output capture, returning the completed process.

methods.name: interpreter_version
methods.description: Retrieves the version string of a given Python interpreter.

methods.name: get_supported_python_versions
methods.description: Extracts supported Python versions from pyproject.toml classifiers.

methods.name: find_python_interpreters
methods.description: Finds Python interpreters based on the specified mode, e.g., manylinux.

methods.name: _find_manylinux_interpreters
methods.description: Locates supported Python interpreters in the /opt/python directory for manylinux.

methods.name: venv
methods.description: Creates a temporary virtual environment using a specified interpreter.

methods.name: Builder.build_wheel
methods.description: Builds a wheel package into the specified destination directory.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for the build script.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function orchestrating the build process based on arguments.
